hints.title: Longest Common Subsequence Reduction
hints.text: The minimum number of deletions equals the sum of both string lengths minus two times the length of their longest common subsequence.

hints.title: Two-Dimensional DP Recurrence
hints.text: If characters match, extend the diagonal value by one. If they differ, take the maximum of skipping a character from either string.

hints.title: Space-Optimized Single Row DP
hints.text: Compute the longest common subsequence using a 1D array of size n plus one. Update dp array for each character of word1. Return m plus n minus two times dp[n].

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(M * N) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursively branching over delete options explores exponential O(2^(M+N)) states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Rolling 1D array reduces space from O(M * N) down to O(min(M, N)) while maintaining quadratic runtime.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize the direct reduction to LCS and express deletions as m + n - 2*LCS.
